metadata.description: Language-agnostic workflow plugins for Claude Code and Codex: commits, PRs, reviews, releases, dependency updates, research, and multi-model collaboration.

plugins.name: weave
plugins.description: Run independent, adversarial AI participants via sub-agents or model CLIs to brainstorm, refine, plan, execute, architect, review, and synthesize.

plugins.name: rebase
plugins.description: Rebase onto remote trunk with a file-overlap reading before the replay, conflict resolution, and quality gate verification.

plugins.name: changelog
plugins.description: Generate and maintain categorized changelog entries from branch commits and PR context.

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: TDD bug-fix workflow: reproduce bugs as failing tests, determine root cause, fix, and verify.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Create git commits following project conventions with format enforcement and safety checks.

plugins.name: model-cli
plugins.description: Run a prompt through one AI CLI at a time: agy (Gemini), codex (GPT), or cursor's agent, with fallback between tiers.

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: Draft, refresh, rewrite, and review PR descriptions, and draft merge commit messages, from the branch diff.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research topics and assess decisions with pinned, captured sources in dated folders. Resume, re-verify, report. Clones dependencies at pinned versions.

plugins.name: slop
plugins.description: Audit a branch's commits or a repo's tracked files for AI slop and brittle references; fix through fixup or atomic commits.

plugins.name: tailwind
plugins.description: Detect and fix inconsistent spacing, margin/gap mixing, and padding asymmetry in Tailwind CSS layouts.

plugins.name: pytest-optimizer
plugins.description: Profile and optimize pytest suites. Ranks and applies safe speedups as verified, independent commits.

plugins.name: spike
plugins.description: Run no-commit spikes, strategy bakeoffs, or multi-round convergence in git worktrees. Tests ideas against quality gates and returns a commit-by-commit implementation plan.

plugins.name: action
plugins.description: Convert tickets to branches in isolated worktrees. Uses team branch conventions, lands gated commits, and supports parallel tickets.

plugins.name: lean
plugins.description: Writing discipline and cleanup tools for tight, slop-free prose and code.

plugins.name: double-check
plugins.description: Forces verification requests to return re-derived answers instead of diffs against prior turns. The align skill restates a chat's analysis standalone after a revision-log reply.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Cut and bump releases with safe defaults (no automatic push/tag). Rolls out releases to downstream consumers with CI verification.

plugins.name: merge-pr
plugins.description: Merge PRs matching repo history conventions. Includes readiness checks, CI watching, stack detection, and automated rebasing.

plugins.name: business
plugins.description: Measure and report the business value of AI workflows from provenance-tagged data, in engineer-hours and cycle time, never currency.

plugins.name: github-actions
plugins.description: Update GitHub Actions pins fleet-wide. Verifies tags, researches release notes, commits each action separately, and supersedes Dependabot PRs.

plugins.name: situate
plugins.description: Gain situational awareness before modifying code. Scans branches, PRs, tickets, and project conventions to orient the agent and verify the work required.

plugins.name: terraform
plugins.description: Upgrade Terraform and OpenTofu versions. Discovers every root module, moves provider constraints together because they combine across modules, and refreshes lock files.

plugins.name: ruff
plugins.description: Upgrade Ruff across repositories. Works out which new rules can fire against each repo's select list and lands one reviewed commit per rule, citing the upstream rule doc.

plugins.name: gh
plugins.description: File durable GitHub issues with reproductions, pinned links, and stripped PII. Enforces a markdown writing discipline reusable for any PR, comment, or ticket.

plugins.name: git-branch
plugins.description: Rebuild branch history into atomic commits (byte-identical), or reimplement from scratch using existing tests as the spec. Includes an interactive-rebase toolkit.

plugins.name: package-updater
plugins.description: Update dependencies and toolchains across repositories. Checks the supply-chain cooldown first when one is configured, then commits toolchain, named bumps, and lockfile refreshes separately with release notes cited.

plugins.name: disk
plugins.description: Safely reclaim disk space. Classifies consumers as cache, redundant copy, or history, deleting only what is proven safe.

plugins.name: ticket
plugins.description: Manage work across trackers (Linear, Jira, GitHub, etc.) respecting each platform's native object graph. Drafts durable tickets focused on invariants.

plugins.name: respond
plugins.description: Screen review feedback from humans or bots before changing code. Verifies claims against facts and project decisions. Valid findings become gated, atomic commits; invalid ones get evidence-backed replies.

plugins.name: self-improvement
plugins.description: Mine local agent prompt history for how the skill catalog is really used, then land the changes that usage evidence supports.

plugins.name: repo-skills
plugins.description: Derive a repository's own agent skills from its docs, git history, CI, shell history, and AI transcripts, test each with and without itself, and land them in two commits.

plugins.name: agent-messaging
plugins.description: Message another running Claude Code or Codex session, and verify who actually sent an incoming message.

plugins.name: skill-style
plugins.description: Hold SKILL.md files to a deletion test: a line stays only when removing it would change what the agent does. Frontmatter, code blocks, and sections survive verbatim.

plugins.name: scholar
plugins.description: Distil a checkable ontology from a codebase, a repository set, or a written corpus. Types, controlled vocabulary, cited and measured evidence.

plugins.name: goal-planner
plugins.description: Print, synthesize, and audit portable goals; keep approved planning profiles and numbered goal specifications without activating work.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Write or rephrase copy for the reader who will use it, from a brief of who they are, what they came to do, where it renders, when they arrive, and why it matters.
